intro.paragraph1: Digital marketer from Prayagraj with hands-on experience in social media, SEO research, content strategy and scriptwriting, plus creative design, short-form video and WordPress development.
intro.paragraph2: I combine audience understanding, research and storytelling with digital tools to create content that supports brand visibility and online growth. My work spans content planning, keyword research, website development, brand identity and AI-assisted creative workflows, and I keep building my skills in SEO and social media strategy.
